hero.label: A dog groomed from scruffy to done, scroll to run it
hero.title: In scruffy.
hero.lede: Calm, unhurried grooming for every size of dog, one at a time, never caged. Scroll and watch Biscuit go from muddy to marvellous.

stages.c: Muddy paws and a matted coat after a week of puddles. A sniff, a treat and a few minutes to settle.
Warm water and a gentle oatmeal shampoo, worked right down to the skin. Twice.
A low, quiet dryer and a brush through every bit, until the coat stands up soft and fluffy.
Scissored by hand, nose to tail, to the shape you asked for. No rushing round the face.
Nails clipped, ears cleaned, a spritz of something nice and a bandana.
A very handsome dog, a photo sent to you, and a text that says come and get me.

prices.title: Pick your dog's size. See the price.
prices.sub: Prices depend on size and coat. If your dog is matted or nervous we'll talk it through first, never surprise you at pick-up.

items: Everything in the bath and tidy
A gentle first bath and dry

visit.title: One dog at a time. No cages, ever.
visit.sub: Your dog has us to themselves from drop-off to pick-up. Here's how a visit goes.

steps.s: A quick chat about the style you want and anything we should know.
A sniff round, a treat, and no rushing. Nervous dogs set the pace.
Bath, dry and trim, one-to-one, in a quiet room.
A text with a photo when they're ready, usually in two to three hours.

promise.text: Every groom is one-to-one in a quiet room. Nervous dogs can come and meet us first, free, as many times as they need.

book.title: Book a groom.
book.sub: Pick a day and a drop-off time. We'll text when your dog is ready, usually two to three hours later.
book.note: Please bring vaccination records on the first visit. Cancel free up to 24 hours before.

footer.fine: Scruff & Co is a made-up business for a concept site.
